# flow-trace

> A Claude Code skill that turns "how does this request work?" into an interactive, animated, step-through HTML page: one hop per file, the real code with the executing lines highlighted, a plain-language note and cost or risk tags per step, with Back, Forward, Play, a scrubber and phase chips.

The repository root is the skill (Agent Skills format: SKILL.md with name and description frontmatter plus assets, scripts and references). Install by placing a copy of the folder, named flow-trace, in the harness's skills directory.

## Start here

- [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md): step-by-step install, verification and uninstall instructions written for an AI agent to execute
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): the instructions the agent follows to build a trace
- [README.md](README.md): what the output looks like, how it works, project presets

## Reference

- [references/lane-presets.md](references/lane-presets.md): lane sets and hop orders for common stacks
- [assets/trace-template.html](assets/trace-template.html): the page template; only the data block is filled per trace
- [scripts/validate_trace.js](scripts/validate_trace.js): pre-publish checks, supports --root to verify file paths exist
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): rules for changing this repository
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): MIT
